title: Extend parameter layout with voice A and voice B groups
description:
Modify Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.cpp ONLY. Replace the empty placeholder definition of shredspace::addVoiceParameters with the complete Voice A and Voice B expert parameter groups. This is a serialized same-file write: do not reformat, reorder, or otherwise alter the GLOBAL/PERF/TIME/STEREO/SCENE code written by task b.2, and do not touch the header.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/Parameters/ParameterIDs.h (VOICE_A_* and VOICE_B_* constants)
- Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.h (addVoiceParameters declaration)
- Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.cpp (existing group helpers written by b.2; follow their exact construction style)

IMPLEMENTATION: write a single file-local static helper, e.g. `static void addOneVoice (juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState::ParameterLayout& layout, bool isVoiceB)`, that adds the 21 parameters for one voice using the VOICE_A_* constants when isVoiceB is false and the VOICE_B_* constants when true, selecting the per-voice default from the pairs below. addVoiceParameters calls it twice (A then B). Every ID must come from shredspace::paramids; never build IDs by string concatenation.

EXACT PARAMETERS — ranges are shared, defaults are listed as (Voice A default / Voice B default). Transcribe literally:
- ENABLE: bool, default true / true
- TIME_RATIO: float 0.25 to 4.0, default 0.5 / 1.0, skewForCentre around 1.0
- FINE_OFFSET: float -50.0 to +50.0 ms, default 0.0 / 0.0, suffix " ms"
- LEVEL: float -60.0 to 0.0 dB, default -12.0 / -10.0, suffix " dB"
- TAIL_SCALE: float 0.25 to 4.0, default 0.65 / 1.2, skewForCentre around 1.0
- ADAPTIVE_ROLE: float 0.0 to 100.0 %, default 40.0 / 85.0
- PAN: float -100.0 to +100.0, default -20.0 / +20.0
- WIDTH: float 0.0 to 200.0 %, default 60.0 / 130.0
- STEREO_OFFSET: float 0.0 to 30.0 ms, default 3.0 / 11.0, suffix " ms"
- CROSS_FEEDBACK: float 0.0 to 100.0 %, default 15.0 / 35.0
- MOD_PHASE: float 0.0 to 180.0 degrees, default 90.0 / 180.0, suffix " deg"
- HPF: float 40.0 to 1500.0 Hz, default 180.0 / 220.0, skewForCentre around 250.0, suffix " Hz"
- LPF: float 2000.0 to 20000.0 Hz, default 6500.0 / 5500.0, skewForCentre around 6000.0, suffix " Hz"
- PRESENCE_FREQ: float 1500.0 to 6000.0 Hz, default 3200.0 / 3200.0, skewForCentre around 3000.0, suffix " Hz"
- PRESENCE_GUARD: float 0.0 to 12.0 dB, default 4.0 / 5.0, suffix " dB"
- ATTACK_SOFTEN: float 0.0 to 100.0 %, default 30.0 / 40.0
- MOD_RATE: float 0.05 to 5.0 Hz, default 0.35 / 0.23, skewForCentre around 0.5, suffix " Hz"
- MOD_DEPTH: float 0.0 to 8.0 ms, default 0.4 / 0.7, suffix " ms"
- DRIFT: float 0.0 to 100.0 %, default 10.0 / 15.0
- DIFFUSION: float 0.0 to 40.0 %, default 8.0 / 12.0
- SATURATION: float 0.0 to 100.0 %, default 8.0 / 10.0

That is 21 parameters per voice, 42 added by this task. Do not add any parameter not in this list, and do not add INTEL_* parameters (task b.4 owns those). No internal state may become a parameter. No third-party dependency. No artist or song names.
acceptance_criteria: Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.cpp defines shredspace::addVoiceParameters with a non-empty body adding 42 parameters (21 for Voice A, 21 for Voice B)

g++ -std=c++20 -fsyntax-only -I JUCE/modules -I Source -DJUCE_GLOBAL_MODULE_SETTINGS_INCLUDED=1 -DJUCE_MODULE_AVAILABLE_juce_audio_processors=1 -DJUCE_STANDALONE_APPLICATION=0 Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.cpp passes with no errors
Every voice parameter uses a shredspace::paramids VOICE_A_ or VOICE_B_ constant rather than a raw or concatenated string ID
The per-voice ranges and defaults in Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.cpp are exactly the values listed in this task description
The addIntelligenceParameters placeholder and the GLOBAL, PERF, TIME, STEREO, and SCENE helpers written by task b.2 are left unmodified
No file outside Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.cpp is created or modified
forbidden_changes: rewrite, reformat, or reorder the GLOBAL, PERF, TIME, STEREO, or SCENE helpers from task b.2
build parameter IDs via string concatenation

allowed: add a file-local static helper that parameterizes voice A vs voice B
choose skew and step details within the stated ranges
forbidden: change any stated range or default
introduce a voice-parameter struct or registry shared with other modules
